semantic_signature.expected_behavior: The compatibility matrix records tested_codex_version as unknown while pinning the tested upstream commit.
semantic_signature.supported_boundary: Static evidence commit is known; installed Codex binary version was not deterministically detected in this inspection environment.
semantic_signature.unsupported_boundary: No shell-out or heuristic version inference is allowed in the deterministic core.

semantic_signature.expected_behavior: A selected profile carrying on-failure is labeled unsupported.
semantic_signature.supported_boundary: Conservative current-surface classification; provenance remains visible.
semantic_signature.unsupported_boundary: This does not claim that every historical/current binary rejects the deprecated value.

semantic_signature.expected_behavior: Codex Scope labels the explicit historical value unsupported instead of presenting it as a current resolved policy.
semantic_signature.supported_boundary: Evidence reflects current docs on 2026-09-22.
semantic_signature.unsupported_boundary: Historical Codex releases may have accepted this value; no version inference is performed.

semantic_signature.expected_behavior: CLI approval_policy=never wins over project/profile/user/system/default candidates.
semantic_signature.supported_boundary: Explicitly supplied CLI override list only.
semantic_signature.unsupported_boundary: Unseen invocation flags remain unresolved unless invocation_complete is asserted.

semantic_signature.expected_behavior: The nested app/.codex/config.toml beats the project-root .codex/config.toml.
semantic_signature.supported_boundary: Trusted local project config layers.
semantic_signature.unsupported_boundary: Managed/cloud constraints that can override or constrain results remain unresolved/unsupported.

semantic_signature.expected_behavior: The root .codex directory used as CODEX_HOME appears only as user config; a nested child project config can still win.
semantic_signature.supported_boundary: Normalized/canonical best-effort local path identity.
semantic_signature.unsupported_boundary: Filesystem identity races and exotic mount behavior are outside the deterministic boundary.

semantic_signature.expected_behavior: The fixture raises CONFIG_PARSE_ERROR.
semantic_signature.supported_boundary: V0.1 zero-dependency safe TOML subset.
semantic_signature.unsupported_boundary: Valid TOML syntax outside the subset may be rejected even when Codex accepts it.

semantic_signature.expected_behavior: sandbox_mode from the selected dev profile wins over the user config when project does not override it.
semantic_signature.supported_boundary: Codex 0.134.0+ profile-v2 separate file semantics modeled as CODEX_HOME/<name>.config.toml.
semantic_signature.unsupported_boundary: Legacy [profiles.name] table selection is not modeled as current behavior.

semantic_signature.expected_behavior: A trusted project approval_policy can supersede the user layer.
semantic_signature.supported_boundary: Explicit trust input only.
semantic_signature.unsupported_boundary: Codex Scope does not auto-detect trust from runtime state.

semantic_signature.expected_behavior: Project model_provider is ignored and the user model_provider remains effective.
semantic_signature.supported_boundary: Current documented/project-protected prefix set modeled by V0.1.
semantic_signature.unsupported_boundary: Future protected keys outside the evidence date are not inferred automatically.

semantic_signature.expected_behavior: The second approval_policy override wins.
semantic_signature.supported_boundary: Ordering of the explicitly supplied repeated -c values.
semantic_signature.unsupported_boundary: Shell/launcher transformations outside the supplied argv are not inferred.

semantic_signature.expected_behavior: When it is the only explicit approval source, the injected system config wins.
semantic_signature.supported_boundary: Deterministic Unix-style system path supplied by the test harness.
semantic_signature.unsupported_boundary: Windows system-config location is not claimed by V0.1.

semantic_signature.expected_behavior: A known-so-far user winner is retained but the final approval_policy state is unresolved.
semantic_signature.supported_boundary: Explicit trust=unknown diagnostic state.
semantic_signature.unsupported_boundary: Codex Scope does not guess trust from repository contents.

semantic_signature.expected_behavior: reasoning_effort is visible with provenance but state=unsupported.
semantic_signature.supported_boundary: Safe parsing/provenance can exceed semantic support.
semantic_signature.unsupported_boundary: Codex Scope does not claim semantic validation for arbitrary Codex config keys.

semantic_signature.expected_behavior: The user value remains effective and the project candidate is ignored.
semantic_signature.supported_boundary: Explicit trust=untrusted input.
semantic_signature.unsupported_boundary: Trust discovery and UI decisions are not performed by Codex Scope.

semantic_signature.expected_behavior: The user approval_policy candidate participates in resolution.
semantic_signature.supported_boundary: Supported V0.1 config keys and safe TOML subset.
semantic_signature.unsupported_boundary: Full Codex config schema and full TOML grammar remain unsupported.

semantic_signature.expected_behavior: An explicit CODEX_HOME environment value is used instead of ~/.codex.
semantic_signature.supported_boundary: Codex Scope models CODEX_HOME and its explicit --codex-home inspection override.
semantic_signature.unsupported_boundary: Home-directory discovery beyond CODEX_HOME and platform-specific environment policy is not inferred.

semantic_signature.expected_behavior: The same path appears as both global and project active instruction sources.
semantic_signature.supported_boundary: Implementation-parity fixture for open upstream issue #34193; this is not desired behavior.
semantic_signature.unsupported_boundary: Do not preserve duplication after upstream canonical-path deduplication lands.

semantic_signature.expected_behavior: A 10-byte budget includes 9 bytes from root and only 1 byte from the child file.
semantic_signature.supported_boundary: Project-document bytes only; global user instructions are outside this project budget.
semantic_signature.unsupported_boundary: Multi-environment host contributions beyond the local filesystem resolver are not modeled.

semantic_signature.expected_behavior: The empty AGENTS.override.md is ignored after selection and AGENTS.md is also ignored because it lost discovery precedence.
semantic_signature.supported_boundary: Pinned to current openai/codex implementation evidence where metadata discovery precedes content filtering.
semantic_signature.unsupported_boundary: If upstream changes discovery to skip empty project candidates before filename selection, this rule must become behavior_drift and be updated.

semantic_signature.expected_behavior: TEAM.md is selected when no override or AGENTS.md exists in the directory.
semantic_signature.supported_boundary: Safe plain fallback filenames supplied by config.
semantic_signature.unsupported_boundary: Path-like fallback entries and executor-specific invalid filenames are outside the V0.1 fallback parser contract.

semantic_signature.expected_behavior: AGENTS.md is active as the global instruction source.

semantic_signature.supported_boundary: Readable local files under the supplied Codex home.

semantic_signature.unsupported_boundary: Model adherence to either instruction file is outside inspection.

semantic_signature.expected_behavior: With no overriding value the project instruction byte limit is 32768.
semantic_signature.supported_boundary: Resolver-critical built-in default at the pinned evidence commit.

retention.migration_policy: Historical snapshot content is immutable. Future schema changes require an explicit migration artifact; current evidence updates create a new snapshot.
